warnings: Cautions: 1. Discontinue use if the following symptoms occur. Consult a dermatologist if symptoms persist. 1) Redness, swelling, itching, or irritation during use. 2) Similar symptoms appear on applied areas after sun exposure. 2. Do not use on wounds, eczema, or inflamed skin. 3. Avoid contact with eyes. Rinse immediately if contact occurs.
